```python
import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import cv2


def main():
    fallback = {
        "type": "other",
        "description": "无法确定图片类型",
        "important_components": [],
        "code_relevant_information": ""
    }
    try:
        image_path = sys.argv[1]
        ocr_text = "output Tape Input"

        data = np.fromfile(image_path, dtype=np.uint8)
        img = cv2.imdecode(data, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        if img is None:
            raise ValueError("Image decode failed")

        h, w = img.shape[:2]
        gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        white_ratio = float(np.mean(gray > 230))

        step_r = max(1, h // 50)
        step_c = max(1, w // 50)
        sample = img[::step_r, ::step_c]
        sample_px = sample.reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.int32)
        unique_cols = len(np.unique(sample_px, axis=0)) if len(sample_px) > 0 else 0
        is_diagram = white_ratio > 0.15 and unique_cols < 200

        words = set(ocr_text.lower().replace('\n', ' ').split())

        exp_kw = {
            "loss", "epoch", "accuracy", "precision", "recall", "f1",
            "auc", "roc", "score", "confusion", "matrix", "baseline",
            "acc", "err", "error", "metric",
            "准确率", "损失", "曲线", "柱状", "对比", "性能", "指标"
        }
        arch_kw = {
            "cnn", "transformer", "attention", "encoder", "decoder",
            "block", "embedding", "classifier", "alexnet", "resnet",
            "vgg", "googlenet", "bert", "gpt", "lstm", "gru", "rnn",
            "conv", "pooling", "backbone", "module", "feature",
            "extractor", "layer", "network", "model"
        }
        flow_kw = {
            "input", "output", "forward", "flow", "tape", "memory",
            "buffer", "pipeline", "stage", "process"
        }
        ds_kw = {
            "dataset", "sample", "class", "category", "test", "val",
            "image", "data", "split", "subset", "corpus", "benchmark"
        }

        exp_h = words & exp_kw
        arch_h = words & arch_kw
        flow_h = words & flow_kw
        ds_h = words & ds_kw

        name_map = {
            "cnn": "CNN", "bert": "BERT", "gpt": "GPT",
            "lstm": "LSTM", "gru": "GRU", "rnn": "RNN",
            "fc": "FC", "vgg": "VGG", "alexnet": "AlexNet",
            "resnet": "ResNet", "googlenet": "GoogLeNet",
            "input": "Input", "output": "Output", "tape": "Tape",
            "accuracy": "Accuracy", "loss": "Loss", "f1": "F1",
            "precision": "Precision", "recall": "Recall", "auc": "AUC",
            "transformer": "Transformer", "attention": "Attention",
            "encoder": "Encoder", "decoder": "Decoder",
            "block": "Block", "embedding": "Embedding",
            "classifier": "Classifier", "feature": "Feature",
            "extractor": "Extractor", "epoch": "Epoch",
            "memory": "Memory", "buffer": "Buffer",
            "network": "Network", "model": "Model", "layer": "Layer",
            "conv": "Convolution", "pooling": "Pooling",
            "backbone": "Backbone", "module": "Module",
            "pipeline": "Pipeline", "stage": "Stage"
        }

        def fmt(word):
            return name_map.get(word, word.title())

        if exp_h:
            model_kw = {
                "alexnet", "resnet", "vgg", "googlenet",
                "cnn", "transformer", "bert", "gpt",
                "lstm", "gru", "rnn"
            }
            metric_kw = {
                "accuracy", "loss", "precision", "recall",
                "f1", "auc", "score", "epoch"
            }
            comps = [
                fmt(w) for w in sorted(exp_h)
                if w in model_kw or w in metric_kw
            ]
            result = {
                "type": "experiment_result",
                "description": "展示实验结果和性能指标对比",
                "important_components": comps,
                "code_relevant_information":
                    "需要实现模型训练和评估流程，记录并对比各项性能指标"
            }
        elif arch_h:
            comps = [fmt(w) for w in sorted(arch_h)]
            result = {
                "type": "architecture",
                "description":
                    "展示模型架构和网络结构，包含" + "、".join(comps),
                "important_components": comps,
                "code_relevant_information":
                    "需要实现" + "、".join(comps) + "等组件及其数据流处理逻辑"
            }
        elif flow_h and (is_diagram or len(flow_h) >= 2):
            comps = [fmt(w) for w in sorted(flow_h)]
            result = {
                "type": "architecture",
                "description":
                    "展示模型数据流结构，包含" + "、".join(comps) + "等组件",
                "important_components": comps,
                "code_relevant_information":
                    "需要实现" + "、".join(comps) + "等组件的数据流处理逻辑"
            }
        elif ds_h:
            result = {
                "type": "dataset",
                "description": "展示数据集样本或数据示例",
                "important_components": [],
                "
